signals.text: Site built Dec 2025 to Jan 2026 by an agency; links to an electrician's site; may be hidden from Google (check)

bestTime: Tue to Thu, 7:30 to 8:30am, or 5 to 6:30pm

sections.label: Before you dial
sections.body:
Who: Stephen, director at SJ Joiners, Falkirk.
Why them: a new agency-built site with faults: it links to an electrician's site and may be hidden from Google.
Best time: Tue to Thu, 7:30 to 8:30am, or 5 to 6:30pm.
Ltd company: tick CTPS (and TPS if it's a personal mobile) in the desk before you dial.
What you want: a 15-minute chat, on the phone or you pop in.
CHECK FIRST: search Google for site:buildersfalkirk.co.uk. If nothing comes up, you can say the site may be hidden from Google. If pages show, don't say it. The site was built by an agency Dec 2025 to Jan 2026, so pitch fixing it, not a rebuild.
Stand up, slow down on your name, and stop talking after every question.

sections.label: If someone else answers
sections.body:
Hi, it's Dean Finlayson, is Stephen about?
_(if they ask what it's about)_ It's about how folk find SJ Joiners online. Is Stephen the right person for that, or is it someone else?
_(if Stephen is out)_ No bother. When's the best time to catch them? _(write their name in the note)_

sections.label: Opener
sections.body:
Hi Stephen, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One. _(slow)_
This is a cold call, so I'll be quick. Can I have 30 seconds to say why I'm calling, and you tell me if it's worth carrying on?
_(stop and wait)_
sections.original:
Hi Stephen, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One. _(slow)_
This is a cold call, so I'll be quick. Can I have 30 seconds to say why I'm calling, and you tell me if it's worth carrying on?
_(stop and wait)_

sections.label: Why I'm calling
sections.body:
The reason I'm calling is your website. It's quite new, but I spotted a couple of things on it, like a link that goes to an electrician's site, that could be costing you calls.
Is that something you've noticed, or am I way off?

sections.label: Questions
sections.body:
Q: Who looks after the website for you just now?
Q: When did someone last try it on their phone, start to finish?
Q: Do you get many enquiries through it, or is it mostly calls?
Listen for: nobody looking after the site, enquiries drying up, a phone call they didn't get.

sections.label: If it's a problem for them
sections.body:
That's what I do. I'll send you a short list of the three to five things I'd fix first, with screenshots. You can fix them yourself, or I'll do it. Either way it's yours to keep.
I'm local, I build it myself, and you deal with me, not a call centre.

sections.label: The ask
sections.body:
Easier to show you than explain. Fifteen minutes, on the phone or I'll pop in to you. Tuesday at 8, or Thursday after 5, which is better?
_(if they hesitate)_ No commitment. If it's not for you, no bother at all.

sections.label: If they push back
sections.body:
They: Somebody already does our website.
You: Good, then the list will make their life easy. It's just the things I'd fix first. Want me to send it over?

They: I'm not interested.
You: Fair enough, most folk aren't till they know why I'm calling. Quick one before I go: is getting found online something you've got covered?

They: Send me an email.
You: Will do. So I don't send you something you'll bin, what matters more to you right now, more enquiries or less time on the phone?

They: How much is it?
You: Depends what you need. It's a one-off build and then a small monthly. I'd rather show you first than throw a number at you. Fifteen minutes, I could pop in?

They: Don't call me again.
You: No problem, I'll take you off. Sorry for the interruption, all the best. _(Log as Do not call)_

sections.body: Hi Stephen, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One in Edinburgh. I'm calling about a couple of things on your website that could be costing you calls. I'll drop you a text with what I mean. You can get me back on this number. Again, it's Dean from Level One. Cheers.
